_comment: Anthropic list prices per model, USD per million tokens, for the run pane's per-agent USD estimate. Taken from the claude-api skill's model reference (Current Models table, cached 2026-09-25; pricing page https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing). cacheRead is the model's own cache-read rate; cacheWrite is the 5-minute cache write at 1.25 x input. The figure drawn is a list-price estimate: partner platforms, batch, fast mode and 1-hour cache writes differ. Bump with the plugin version when a price moves.
